user.title: Set up ThermoSmart

menu_options.add_system: Set up global controls (Summer & Vacation mode)

user.description: Choose whether to set up the global ThermoSmart controls (Summer & Vacation mode) or add a new heating zone.

add_system.title: Global Controls
add_system.description: Sets up the global Summer mode select (Automatic / On / Off) and Vacation switch. No thermostat required. Both controls apply to all zones simultaneously.

add_zone.title: Step 1 – Devices & Sensors
add_zone.description: Select the TRVs and sensors for this heating zone. Calibration entities and quirk switches are detected automatically.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. Living Room)
data.window_open_delay: Heating off – delay after window opens
data.window_close_delay: Heating on – delay after window closes

data_description.zone_control_mode: This is the zone default. Individual TRVs can override it in the next step.
data_description.ext_temp_threshold: External temperature is written only after the difference reaches this threshold.

data.state_setting_value: Desired option, state, or HVAC mode

data_description.state_setting_entity: Optional select, switch, or climate entity to enforce before TRV control writes.

schedule.title: Step 4 – Temperatures & Schedule
schedule.description:
Daily flow: Night → Comfort → Night

When all persons are away, ThermoSmart automatically switches to the away temperature – regardless of the schedule.

data.away_temp: Away temperature (automatically when everyone is gone)
data.eco_temp: Eco temperature (energy saving, between night and comfort)

data_description.schedule_enabled: When disabled, comfort temperature is active around the clock – no automatic day/night switching.
data_description.sched_wd_morning: Comfort temperature should be reached by this time – ThermoSmart preheats automatically in advance
data_description.sched_wd_night: Night temperature applies from this time
data_description.sched_we_morning: Comfort temperature should be reached by this time – ThermoSmart preheats automatically in advance
data_description.sched_we_night: Night temperature applies from this time
data_description.away_temp: Only applied automatically when presence detection is configured (Step 3). Can also be set manually via the mode select.
data_description.eco_temp: Used when the mode select is manually set to 'Eco'. Not applied automatically.
data_description.window_open_temp: Target temperature while a window is open. For thermostats that do not support very low setpoints, use a higher value such as 10 °C.

presence.title: Step 5 – Presence
presence.description:
Who is home? ThermoSmart automatically switches to away mode when everyone leaves.

Leave the person list empty to disable automatic away detection – ThermoSmart will then follow only the schedule.

weather.title: Step 6 – Weather & Outdoor Sensors
weather.description: All fields optional – own sensors take priority over the weather entity. The system works without weather data too.

data_description.weather_entity: Used for forecasts and forecast suppression. Leave empty if using only own sensors.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Own sensors are more accurate than the weather entity and are preferred.

error.entity_not_found: Weather entity not found. Please select a valid entity or leave the field empty.
error.required: At least one thermostat / TRV is required.
error.night_temp_too_high: Night temperature must be lower than comfort temperature.
error.away_temp_too_high: Away temperature must not be higher than night temperature.

abort.system_already_configured: The global ThermoSmart controls are already set up.
abort.system_no_options: ThermoSmart System has no configurable options. Use the Summer mode select and the Vacation switch to control all zones.
